Chore: add ISSUE markdown files for PRD compliance tasks

This branch adds .github/ISSUES/ with ready-to-create GitHub Issue markdown files to help the team track and implement PRD v2.1 compliance work for the Hosté Admin Dashboard. Files include acceptance criteria, test notes, and estimates.

Files added (.github/ISSUES/):
- 0001-implement-payment-model.md
- 0002-add-engagement-models.md
- 0003-idempotent-payout-refund-endpoints.md
- 0004-staff-auth-jwt-otp.md
- 0005-enforce-employmentstatus-rbac.md
- 0006-central-dto-sanitizer.md
- 0007-verification-circle.md
- 0008-openapi-swagger.md
- 0009-pii-logging-and-audit-encryption.md
- 0010-tests-and-ci.md
- 0011-frontend-sidebar-topnav.md
- 0012-badge-counts-and-global-search.md
- README.md (ISSUES folder usage instructions)

Usage instructions
1. Review the markdown files under .github/ISSUES/
2. Copy/paste the title and body into new GitHub Issues (or import them via automation)
3. Apply labels, assignees, and milestones as appropriate

Suggested reviewers: @HostesAPP/maintainers
